exact_statement: For every finite simple graph G and every pair of distinct edges e,f, if F is a uniformly random forest of G, then Pr(e in F | f in F) <= Pr(e in F).
scope_notes: The inherited marked-03 K5-minus-34 stabilizer polynomial has five orbit variables a,b,c,d,e; three complete two-variable slices are already frozen and count only as inherited evidence.
The immediate target is the complete real distinguished component after eliminating the singleton variable b, including every A_b=0 wall and all signs of a,c,d,e.
Even a complete five-variable stabilizer theorem erases three transverse independent-edge directions and is not by itself OPG-1757 closure.
A negative determinant or xi point counts only with an exact path or complete chamber proof placing it in the positive-anchor component of P>0.
